text:
Amanda: Hey team — need quick approval. Accelerator customer (NeonLabs) wants a 4-week POC. Security onboarding hit a delay (SCIM/SSO) so they asked for extra credits to finish a full eval. Can we do a one-off 50k token credit + extended trial (45 days)? They'd sign a 12mo commit if POC goes well. TL;DR: promo credit + expiration + short SSO workaround requested.

Raj: +1 from pre-sales. Demo scheduled Tue, CTO is the champion. If we don't move fast they'll punt to vendor-X.

Clara: What's the expected ACV/commit? Need numbers to justify a promo this size.

Amanda: Sales forecast: $120k ARR year 1 (3 paid seats + embedding usage). High confidence from champion.

Tom: For dealdesk escalation: 50k tokens ~= $1.2k list value. We need: legal entity name, signing authority, ACV forecast, and a short business justification. Also recommend scoping the credit: route-limited and time-limited.

Jen: Security note — SSO won't be ready before the POC due to SCIM work. Proposed workaround: provision IP-restricted demo workspace, redact logs, and have customer sign a temporary data-handling attestation. Need customer security contact on the ticket.

Clara: If they commit to $120k MRR (typo: ARR) for 12mo, RevOps can approve up to a 50% match credit up to $6k for the first 90 days + a 60-day trial extension. Need written confirmation (email) and a Rep approval. @tom can you draft exception terms?

Tom: Will draft. Suggested exception language: "Promotional credit: 50,000 tokens issued to NeonLabs; expires 45 days from issuance; contingent on fully-executed MSA or purchase order within 60 days; revocable for TOS violation. Credit limited to demo routes only (no export keys)." I'll push into the dealdesk queue and ping Legal.

Finance-bot: FYI — promotional credits must be recorded as contra-revenue. Promo credits <= $6k can be approved by RevOps/DealDesk without exec finance signoff. Any higher amount routes to FP&A.

Amanda: Sending customer details now in a separate DM to Tom and Clara. I'll ask NeonLabs to sign the attestation today and provide their security contact. Thanks. :raised_hands:

Ops-bot: Demo workspace created: ip `3.14.159.26` — credentials delivered to NeonLabs legal contact out-of-band.

Tom: Drafted exception and added required fields. Leaving placeholder for ACV confirmation in the deal form. If RevOps approves the $6k match I'll mark as approved and generate the credit code.

Clara: Approved from RevOps contingent on email confirmation from NeonLabs and security attestation signed. Approving the $6k maximum promo match + 45-day credit expiry.

Amanda: Customer emailed confirmation and uploaded the attestation. Requesting final sign-off from @tom and @clara so I can issue the promo code today.

Tom: Signing off. I'll attach the exception doc to the order and set expiry to 45 days.

Amanda: Great — issuing promo now and adding the credit note to the PO. Will follow up if NeonLabs asks for anything else.

Raj: Nice work team.

Jen: Note for audit — store the attestation in the shared security folder and link to the order.

Amanda: Will do. :white_check_mark:
